coder_notes: Early Phase 1 personalised neoantigen peptide vaccine (excluded intervention type) in mixed glioma (GBM WHO grade IV named in inclusion alongside grade II/III gliomas). Treatment setting internally inconsistent: title says newly diagnosed, arm label and inclusion say recurrent malignant glioma, intervention text says vaccine given before maintenance TMZ after chemoradiation; coded unclear. Temozolomide listed as soc_backbone because the protocol text places vaccinations before maintenance TMZ cycles, though it is not a registered intervention and may not apply to recurrent patients. Adjuvants listed in the registered intervention are coded as vaccine components (excluded_intervention_type) with shared regimen_id; flagged uncertain since several are licensed or immunomodulatory agents. Record lists many exploratory blood/tissue biomarkers (GFAP, YKL-40, miR-210, H3F3A, ATRX, TERT etc.); only the main named classes are listed. No candidate, so no TE/PK coding of a candidate.
